name: Bellatrix vom Norden

photo.caption: Bellatrix (far right) with her littermates, 4 weeks old

facts.label: Parents
facts.value: Ivo vom Hafen x Aurora vom Norden

bio: Bellatrix is a beautiful reverse brindle puppy from Aurora's first litter by Ivo vom Hafen. She is developing a good, stable temperament, and the plan is to breed her for the first time in 2028 if she passes health testing and earns at least a CGC title.
